unlisted_practices: Using a policy learning tree to allocate scarce therapeutics (monoclonal antibodies) under resource constraint
Comparing ML-based allocation with observed allocation and with a point-based screening score using expected hospitalization risk differences

screen.reason: The study develops and retrospectively evaluates a machine learning policy learning tree (PLT) algorithm for allocating scarce monoclonal antibodies compared to historical allocation and a standard scoring system, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
